pieces.gap: The camera has no lookahead in practice. In updateView (stealth/js/game.js about lines 494-500) the target is tx = P.x + P.vx*0.32, smoothed with rate 4. At a steady speed v, exponential follow lags by v/rate = 0.25v, so the net lead is 0.32v - 0.25v = 0.07v: about 9 world px (7-10 screen px) at the 128 px/s run. Measured: after 3s of running right or down, the player's screen position moved only -6 to -10px in both portrait and landscape. Fix: (1) In updatePlayer after field.move, keep a measured velocity, e.g. P.avx += ((P.x-before.x)/dt - P.avx)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*10)) and the same for P.avy, so the lead follows real motion and not thumb intent. (2) In updateView keep a separate smoothed lead vector: leadTarget = (P.avx, P.avy)*0.6, magnitude capped at min(W,H)/view.z*0.28 (about 130 world px on a phone); view.lead eases toward it at rate 2.5; then tx = P.x + view.lead.x, with the same for ty (plus the existing portrait +70/tz).
